skill.name: frontend-design
skill.description: Guides AI agents to build polished frontend interfaces with distinctive visual direction, production-quality layout, typography, motion, and styling choices.
skill.summary: Frontend design guidance for polished, distinctive web UI work.
skill.author: 7Spade

content.value_statement: Generic UI output makes products feel unfinished and hard to trust. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward polished frontend work with stronger visual direction.
actual_capabilities: Guides creation of frontend components, pages, dashboards, and applications.
Encourages clear aesthetic direction before implementation begins.
Provides guidance for typography, color, motion, spacing, and background detail.
Supports HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, and similar frontend outputs.
Pushes generated interfaces away from common generic AI design patterns.
Helps match implementation complexity to the chosen visual direction.
limitations: It provides design guidance, not a full design system or component library.
It does not include executable scripts, templates, or generated assets.
Final accessibility, browser support, and performance still need project review.
Results depend on the user providing useful product, audience, and technical context.

use_cases.title: Create a Product Dashboard
use_cases.description: Turn rough dashboard requirements into a polished interface with stronger hierarchy, layout, and interaction details.

use_cases.title: Improve a Landing Page
use_cases.description: Refine a marketing page so the layout, typography, motion, and visual tone feel more intentional.

use_cases.title: Style Application Components
use_cases.description: Apply a distinctive visual direction to components while keeping the implementation practical for frontend development.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Simple Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single page or section.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to create a polished web page for [product or topic]. Include responsive HTML and CSS with a clear visual direction.

prompt_templates.title: Refine an Existing Interface
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve a current UI without changing its purpose.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to improve this interface: [paste description]. Keep the workflow intact, but upgrade layout, typography, color, and details.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Dashboard Experience
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a dense product or operations view.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to design a dashboard for [users]. Include key states, responsive layout, hierarchy, and interaction details for repeated use.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Distinctive Design System Direction
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a broader visual language.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to define and implement a distinctive frontend direction for [product]. Provide components, layout rules, motion guidance, and styling rationale.

output_examples.input: A SaaS analytics dashboard needs to feel premium and useful for daily monitoring.
output_examples.output: A responsive dashboard concept with focused navigation, compact data panels, strong typography, controlled color accents, and practical hover states.

output_examples.input: A landing page for a creative tool feels too generic.
output_examples.output: A revised page direction with a stronger visual theme, bolder composition, characterful typography, motion cues, and clearer conversion sections.

output_examples.input: A React component needs better styling and micro-interactions.
output_examples.output: A component treatment with refined spacing, purposeful states, accessible contrast targets, and animation choices that support the interaction.

best_practices: Provide the audience, product context, technical stack, and desired tone before asking for implementation.
Ask for responsive states, empty states, loading states, and interaction details when building application UI.
Review accessibility, performance, and brand fit before using generated frontend code in production.
anti_patterns: Do not ask only for a beautiful design without explaining the product or users.
Do not accept heavy animation or visual effects when the interface needs speed and clarity.
Do not treat generated styling as a substitute for accessibility and browser testing.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create frontend pages, components, dashboards, and applications with stronger visual direction and production-quality styling.

faq.question: Does it include code files or scripts?
faq.answer: No. The skill is instruction-only and guides the AI agent during frontend design and implementation tasks.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it work with React or Vue?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill explicitly mentions React, Vue, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and similar frontend outputs.

faq.question: Is it focused on marketing pages only?
faq.answer: No. It also applies to dashboards, applications, web components, artifacts, and general UI styling tasks.

faq.question: What should I provide for best results?
faq.answer: Provide user goals, product context, technical constraints, preferred tone, and any existing brand or accessibility requirements.
